admission.justification: Paced non-host projection/healing, bounded interested landing probes and independent provider safety jointly reduce unnecessary work without concealing failed pending invalidations, completed facts or leftover fleets. Host activity is separately publication/boot driven and is not polled or healed by periodic full/degraded reconciliation; that exception is not an assurance that missed host invalidations are recovered. No one member guarantees the remaining combination.

guarantee: Native-watch completion pacing, path-directed refresh, transaction-bound own-write suppression and honest owner accounting together avoid self-echo work while retaining failed invalidations and healing missed inputs in the non-host healing domains. A due full reconciliation of those domains is independent of partial traffic, and the noncooperating store-append race is explicitly bounded by that healing path. HOST_ACTIVITY is deliberately excluded from periodic full-heal and degraded rereads: admitted host input is retained; initial dashboard intake and host-publication invalidation use the separately qualified host reader and boot reconciliation. A missed host-activity invalidation is not promised recovery by the periodic healing deadline. Terminal arcs with no valid final receive only their exact one permitted finishing attempt, including startup, while abandoned/build-only history remains probe-free. Diagnostic windows state incompleteness; no measured processor share, latency or installation acceptance follows from this guarantee. Serving-bound landing discovery and new probe admission require actual state-stream interest and use bounded current-identity semantic-answer due state; explicit unbound reads remain explicit. Provider safety remains periodic independently of page interest or launch-authority absence so labelled leftovers are not hidden.
title: Truthful paced dashboard background work
